fullPassage: In everyday life, we use attention to predict where we should pay attention. Different environments create different expectations. This was profoundly illustrated by the scientist Jared Diamond in his book Guns, Germs, and Steel. He describes an adventure wandering through the New Guinea jungle with native New Guineans. He relates that these natives tend to perform poorly at tasks Westerners have been trained to do since childhood. But they are hardly stupid. They can detect the most subtle changes in the jungle, good for following the tracks of a predator or for finding the way back home. They know which insects to leave alone, know where food exists, can build and tear down shelters with ease. Diamond, who had never spent time in such places, has no ability to pay attention to these things. Were he to be tested on such tasks, he also would perform poorly.

✅ ④ trained: 'have been trained to do' 현재완료 수동태. 과거분사 정상.

questions.passage: In everyday life, we use attention to predict where we should pay attention. Different environments create different expectations. This was profoundly illustrated by the scientist Jared Diamond in his book Guns, Germs, and Steel. He describes an adventure wandering through the New Guinea jungle with native New Guineans. He relates that these natives tend to perform poorly at tasks Westerners have been trained to do since childhood. But they are <u>hardly stupid</u>. They can detect the most subtle changes in the jungle, good for following the tracks of a predator or for finding the way back home. They know which insects to leave alone, know where food exists, can build and tear down shelters with ease. Diamond, who had never spent time in such places, has no ability to pay attention to these things. Were he to be tested on such tasks, he also would perform poorly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>hardly stupid</u>가 함축하는 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'hardly stupid'은 정글 환경에서 원주민의 능력이 충분히 지적임을 강조한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 서양식 교육을 받으면 더 똑똑해질 가능성이 있다.
→ 본문: 교육 가능성 언급 없음.

✅ ② 각자의 환경에서 고도로 발달된 지적 능력을 갖추고 있다. ←정답
→ 근거: 바로 뒤 'detect subtle changes, know insects, know food, build shelters with ease'.

❌ ③ 생존 능력은 있지만 체계적 사고력은 부족하다.
→ 본문: 사고력 부족 언급 없음. hardly stupid은 오히려 지적임 강조.

❌ ④ 본능에 의존하여 단순한 기술만 익힌 것이다.
→ 본문: 단순/본능 구분 없음. detect subtle changes는 정교한 능력.
det.tip: hardly stupid = 결코 멍청하지 않다. 이중부정 = 강한 긍정.
